description: Labelled retrieval set for `manage.py rag_eval`. Each query names the corpus documents that should come back. Queries with an empty `relevant` list SHOULD return nothing at all — the score cutoff is supposed to reject them, and a system that always returns its top-k will fail those rather than pass them for free.

kinds.paraphrase: Asks for a concept in the student's own words, sharing few terms with the source. Dense retrieval should handle these.
kinds.lexical: Turns on a specific rare term. Dense embeddings compress rare terms badly; a sparse leg should carry these.
kinds.near_miss: Two corpus documents are plausible; only one is right. Measures precision, not just recall.
kinds.code: The answer lives inside a fenced code block. These fail while markdown ingestion deletes code.
kinds.off_topic: Nothing in the corpus answers this. Success is returning no results.

queries.query: how do I find the value of x when the letter is on both sides
why can I do the same thing to both sides of an equals sign
what is the discriminant
quadratic formula
how can I tell if an equation has no real answers
completing the square
what is the bottom number of a fraction called
least common denominator
do I need a common denominator to multiply fractions
queries.note: The corpus says no; the adjacent addition rule says yes. Retrieving the addition passage alone is a wrong answer that looks right.

queries.query: how do plants make food from sunlight
chlorophyll
what is the Calvin cycle
what do stomata do
what do mitochondria do
queries.note: Both biology documents discuss energy and ATP. Only cell_structure.txt covers respiration.

queries.query: which parts does a plant cell have that an animal cell does not
queries.note: Chloroplasts appear in both documents; the contrast is only in cell_structure.txt.

queries.query: what holds the genetic material in a cell
what is an accumulator variable
how do I repeat something when I do not know how many times
how do I use range to loop from 1 to 10
queries.note: range(1, 11) exists only inside a fenced block. Expected to fail until markdown ingestion stops deleting code.

queries.query: what does print(count) do inside a while loop
queries.note: Same: the loop body is code-only.

queries.query: what is the capital of France
how do I reset my password
who won the world cup in 1998
